title: Finiteness properties and Higman's rope trick
summary: In 1961 Higman proved that every finitely generated recursively presented group embeds into a finitely presented group. In 2018 Leary proved that every finitely generated group embeds into a group of type $FP_2$. One naturally wonders whether analogous results hold for the higher finiteness properties $F_n$ and $FP_n$ ($3 \leq n \leq \infty$), i.e., whether every finitely generated recursively presented group embeds into a group of type $F_n$ and whether every finitely generated group embeds into a group of type $FP_n$.
